test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 14 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which politician was awarded the Sahitya Akademi Award 2021 for 'Mirjafar O Anyanya Natak"?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bratya Basu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Sahitya Akademi Award 2021** will be bestowed on** Bratya Basu** in the genre of Play. 
 
• He has got this recognition for his book '**Mirjafar o Onyanyo Natok**'.
 
• **Bratya Basu** is a politician who is serving as the** current Education Minister of West Bengal since 2021**.
 
• He was also present in the same office in the First Mamata Banerjee ministry.
 
• His constituency is **Dum Dum since 2011**.
 
• He has won many awards like -** Satyen Mitra Puraskar, Banglar Gourab** by **Zee, Prachya Samman**, etc.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sahitya Akademi Award**

 
• Sahitya Akademi Award is given in the field of Literature.
 
• This award is given annually by Sahitya Akademi (India's National Academy of Letters), New Delhi.
 
• It is given in 24 languages including Hindi and English.

 
• The award comprises a plaque and a cash prize of ₹ 1,00,000.
 
• The award's purpose is to recognize and promote excellence in Indian writing and also acknowledge new trends.
 
• Makhanlal Chaturvedi was the first recipient in the Hindi category in the year 1955.
 
• RK Narayan was the first recipient in the English category in the year 1960.
